headline: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Meets President At Palace
seoTitle: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Meets President Prabowo
metaDescription: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka met with President Prabowo Subianto at the Merdeka Palace before traveling to the People's Consultative Assembly.
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka held a meeting with President Prabowo Subianto at the Merdeka Palace.
Following the meeting, the Vice President proceeded to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) building.
Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives Sufmi Dasco Ahmad confirmed the sequence of events but stated he was unaware of the discussion's content.
aiContextParagraph: On November 12, 2026, Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka visited the Merdeka Palace to meet with President Prabowo Subianto. According to reports from multiple media outlets, this meeting occurred immediately prior to the Vice President's departure to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR). Official accounts from the Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives, Sufmi Dasco Ahmad, confirmed that the Vice President met with the President before traveling to the Senayan area, where the legislature is located. While the movement of the Vice President has been acknowledged by legislative leadership, the specific nature and topics of the discussion held at the presidential palace remain undisclosed. Deputy Speaker Dasco Ahmad explicitly stated that he did not have information regarding the substance of the conversation between the two leaders during their brief morning encounter at the palace.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to the high profile of the officials involved and rapid reporting across three major news outlets within a short timeframe.
